# readFCS

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

`readFCS` is a single dependency ([Rcpp](https://github.com/RcppCore/Rcpp)) FCS 3.1 reader; comprised of three sensibly named primary functions, an FCS file can be fully read using:

| function     | Segment | Description                                    |
|--------------|---------|------------------------------------------------|
| readHEADER() | HEADER  | Contains byte offsets for reading all segments |
| readTEXT()   | TEXT    | Keyword-value pairs                            |
| readDATA()   | DATA    | linear (raw) measurement values                |

By design, `readFCS` does not modify the source .fcs data other than reading it into memory for assignment; once available in an environment, users/developers can then access and structure the data as they see fit (e.g., a list of matrices or concatenated data.table).

## Installation

Install `readFCS` from source ([RTools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) needed to build from source (Windows))

``` r
pak::pak("nlaniewski/readFCS")
```
## Read FCS file segments

Included in the package is a single .fcs file for the purpose of examples:

```{r}
fcs.file.path <- system.file("extdata", "CD4 BUV496 (Beads).fcs", package = "readFCS")
```

### readHEADER

`readHEADER()` reads the **HEADER** segment of the FCS file, returning the byte offsets needed to read all primary file segments (namely, **TEXT** and **DATA**).  A `delimiter` attribute is attached to the `TEXT` offsets, specifying how the segment (string) will be split to generate the keyword-value pairs.  `$BYTEORD`, `$PAR`, `$TOT`, and `parameter.names` attributes are attached to the `DATA` offsets, specifying how the segment (binary stream) will be converted to matrix and then named (columns).

```{r}
offsets <- readFCS::readHEADER(fcs.file.path)
```

```{r}
offsets[['version']]
offsets[['TEXT']]
offsets[['DATA']]
```

### readTEXT

`readTEXT()` reads the **TEXT** segment of the FCS file, splitting the string by the delimiter and returning a list of keyword-value pairs.

```{r}
keywords.values <- readFCS::readTEXT(fcs.file.path)
## index the list using keyword names to access their values
keywords.values[['$CYT']]
keywords.values[['TUBENAME']]
keywords.values[['$DATE']]
## index -- list structure
keywords.values[c('$P1N', '$P2N')]
## index -- named vector
unlist(keywords.values[c('$P1N', '$P2N')])
```

### readDATA

`readDATA()` reads the **DATA** segment of the FCS file, converting the binary stream (list mode/row-major) into a matrix of linear (raw) measurement values.

```{r}
DATA <- readFCS::readDATA(fcs.file.path)
## linear measurement values -- forward and side scatter
head(DATA[, c('FSC-A', 'SSC-A')])
## linear measurement values -- fluorescence
head(DATA[, 'BUV496-A', drop = FALSE])
```

## Utility

Combining the return of both `readTEXT()` and `readDATA()` allows for the creation of structured objects (named lists of matrices with attached metadata, class-based S3 objects, etc.); those operations are beyond the scope of this package but `readFCS` should allow users/developers to achieve that utility.
